metadata.title: Micron Stock Surges: Analysts React to Strong MU Earnings Report<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Analysts Love Micron’s Earnings Almost as Much as the Stock Market Does
The question for Micron Technology coming into its earnings was not how big the memory-chip boom is, but how long it can last. Longer than anyone originally thought, appears to be the answer—and analysts and the stock market are rushing to catch up.
